description: Agentic Enterprise UC-2 — normalizes an inbound guest chat message (web widget, mobile app, or voice transcript) into the structured payload the Cruise Concierge playbook consumes (booking_id, intent_hint, sentiment_seed, message_text).

message_id.description: Source-channel id for the inbound message.

guest_id.description: Internal guest identifier (e.g. 'G-78821') if recognized via auth context or loyalty card.

booking_id.description: Booking reference if the guest has an active booking attached to the session (e.g. 'CSC-2026-04412').

loyalty_tier.description: Loyalty tier — used to prioritize handoff and customize tone.

language.description: Detected language of the message (BCP 47 tag, e.g. 'en-US').

intent_hint.description: Best-guess intent — the agent's intent_classify will refine this, but the seed helps routing.

sentiment_seed.description: Initial sentiment score in [-1.0, +1.0] from any inline channel sentiment (e.g. NPS rating attached to the message).

message_text.description: Verbatim message body. Preserved exactly so the agent can re-classify or quote.

received_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the message was received.

extractionInstructions: This blueprint normalizes any inbound guest message regardless of channel. Preserve the verbatim message_text — the ConciergeAgent re-classifies intent server-side; the intent_hint here is a routing seed only, not authoritative.
